questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word meaning: a place to stay.
questions.e: Accommodation has double c and double m.

questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word meaning: needed.
questions.e: Necessary has one c and two s's.

questions.q: Which one of the following words is spelt incorrectly?
questions.e: The correct spelling is receive, by the rule i before e except after c.

questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word meaning: the body that rules a country.
questions.e: Government has an n after the first r, as in govern.

questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word meaning: surroundings.
questions.e: Environment contains the n in -ron-, from environ.

questions.q: Identify the incorrectly spelt word.
questions.e: The correct spelling is Wednesday, with the d before the n.

questions.q: Select the sentence in which every word is correctly spelt.
o: He is a very intelligent student.
questions.e: The wrong forms should be beautiful, extremely and friendly.

questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word meaning: a particular time or event.
questions.e: Occasion has double c and a single s.

questions.q: Find the word whose spelling is wrong.
questions.e: The correct spelling is harassment, with one r. Embarrass has double r.

questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word meaning: achieving an aim.
questions.e: Successful has double c, double s, and ends in a single l.

questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word meaning: careful and diligent.
questions.e: Conscientious is spelt with -scientious, from conscience.

questions.q: Which of these words is NOT correctly spelt?
questions.e: The correct spelling is pronunciation; the noun drops the o of pronounce.

questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word meaning: a list of questions for a survey.
questions.e: Questionnaire has double n and ends in -aire.

questions.q: Choose the sentence that contains no spelling error.
o: We must not neglect our responsibilty.
The doctor prescribed medicine for his ailment.
questions.e: The wrong forms should be responsibility, leniency and embarrassment.

questions.q: Pick the word with a spelling error.
questions.e: The correct spelling is liaison, with two i's.

questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word meaning: to fail to fulfil hope.
questions.e: Disappoint is dis- plus appoint, so one s and double p.

questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word meaning: a peculiar habit.
questions.e: Idiosyncrasy ends in -crasy, like many words from Greek.

questions.q: Choose the wrongly spelt word.
questions.e: The correct spelling is perseverance. Supersede is the only English word ending in -sede.

questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word meaning: close watch over a suspect.
questions.e: Surveillance has double l and ends in -ance.

questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word meaning: relating to medicinal drugs.
questions.e: Pharmaceutical begins with ph and has -ceu- in the middle.
